_comment: marble_trapdoor: the walkway trapdoor's moving parts, an arc sector of the ring for the hole marble_build cuts on a pier in TRAPDOOR_BEARINGS (four lane cells, r 48.05 to the wall foot, over its 6 m pit). Origin the deck point at r 53.989 (mid-hole) on the hole's centre bearing, y 0 the deck, +X radial out, +Z toward increasing bearing. CLOSED IT IS A PIECE OF THE FLOOR WITH ONE LINE ROUND IT: the rim's top wears the iron on its outermost 0.127 m (the floor tile's joint width, a clean dark line round the cut's whole perimeter) and the deck's own flags inside that, both flaps the flags (the floor tile on the lane's cell grid, the deck's COLOR_0 on the deck's path); no straps, knuckles or seam lips, and the seam sits on the tile's joint row with no gap, so closed it is one of the lane's joints. TrapdoorFrame: the rim inside the hole, 0.35 deep, its outer edge the cut itself, its inner edge the lip arc r 48.33 and the wall arc r 59.528 (0.28 m at the lip and the sides, 0.40 at the wall, 0.47 at the bay corners) between radial sides; its skin, inner faces and underside near-black iron ("edge"). TrapdoorLeaf00 (inner, hinged on the lip arc) and TrapdoorLeaf01 (outer, on the wall arc): two 0.15 m stone sectors meeting edge to edge at a seam arc r 53.747, iron undersides and edges; node origin is the hinge AXIS, the chord through the hinge arc's ends at the flap's bottom arris (r 48.118 / 59.262), local +X along it, local +Z toward the free edge: +90 deg about local X hangs it (to 5.77 / 5.90 m). TrapdoorSpikes: pale stone spikes on a 0.9 m grid over the pit floor (y -6.0), tips -5.15..-4.9, 0.45 m clear of the axes. NO colliders: the scene gives the flaps their bodies.
